logline: 星圖在最邊緣寫了一個空白。候不是求救——是不死者把等待做成工作。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 候 — Beyond the Galaxy / Slow Mandarin Jazz (TJ28)

comics.en: A blank at the edge of the star chart.
comics.zh: 星圖在最邊緣寫了一個空白。

comics.en: 候 is not a distress call.
An immortal makes waiting into work.
comics.zh: 是不死者把等待做成工作。

comics.en: TJ28 has arrived; still listening for 候.
